newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Southern Star bids for Circle.
newsitem.headline: Southern Star bids for Circle.

text.p: Film and television production company Southern Star Group Ltd said on Wednesday that it had launched a friendly takeover bid for Circle Communications Plc which valued the London-based television rights group at 9.8 million stg.

Southern Star said it would offer 75 pence in cash for each Circle ordinary share, valuing the target company's total ordinary stock at 8.3 milion stg. It also said it would offer 100 pence cash for each Circle preference share, valued at a total of 1.5 million stg.
Circle ordinary shares last traded at 67.5 pence on May 12.

Southern said Circle ordinary shareholders could also take one quarter of their payment in the form of Southern Star shares on the basis of one Southern Star share for every 80 pence cash equivalent in acceptances.
It said MVI Partners had agreed to accept for its 56 percent stake in the ordinary shares of Circle and for its 91 percent stake in the preference shares.
Each of Circle's directors, holding a total of 0.5 percent of the ordinary shares, had accepted the Southern Star offer.
Circle was listed on London's alternative investment market on July 3 last year, following a placement of four million shares at 170 pence each.
